#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, subprocess, copy

def run(req):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','/app/submission/main.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(req).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

fails = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        fails.append((name, got, want))
        print('FAIL', name, '\n  got ', json.dumps(got), '\n  want', json.dumps(want))
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)

# (a) signature zero padding with P=5 probes
req = {
 "version":1,"window":1,
 "schema":[{"name":"f","type":"FLAG"}],
 "atoms":[{"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"f","at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}}],
 "policy":{"max_width":2,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
 "train":[{"id":"tr","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[True]},{"t":1,"values":[True]}]}],
 "probes":[{"id":"pr","source":"s","rows":[
    {"t":0,"values":[False]},{"t":1,"values":[True]},{"t":2,"values":[False]},
    {"t":3,"values":[True]},{"t":4,"values":[False]}]}],
 "queries":[]}
r = run(req)
check('sig_padding_P5', [c['signature'] for c in r['classes']], ['0a'])
check('sig_members', [c['members'] for c in r['classes']], [1])

# P=4 -> 1 char
req2 = copy.deepcopy(req)
req2['probes'][0]['rows'] = req2['probes'][0]['rows'][:4]
r = run(req2)
check('sig_padding_P4', [c['signature'] for c in r['classes']], ['5'])  # bits 0,2 -> 1+4=5

# P=1 -> '0'
req3 = copy.deepcopy(req)
req3['probes'][0]['rows'] = req3['probes'][0]['rows'][:1]
r = run(req3)
check('sig_padding_P1', [c['signature'] for c in r['classes']], ['0'])

# (b) training source with zero contexts blocks everything
req4 = copy.deepcopy(req)
req4['train'].append({"id":"short","source":"other","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[False]}]})  # < K=... K=1 so 1 row gives a ctx
req4['train'][1] = {"id":"short","source":"other","rows":[]}  # zero rows -> zero contexts
r = run(req4)
check('zero_ctx_source', r['classes'], [])

# (c) per-source pooling: two traces same source
req5 = copy.deepcopy(req)
req5['train'] = [
   {"id":"a","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[True]}]},
   {"id":"b","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[True]}]}]
r = run(req5)
check('pooled_source', [c['members'] for c in r['classes']], [1])

# per-source failure: source with only 1 context, S=2
req6 = copy.deepcopy(req)
req6['policy']['min_support'] = 2
req6['train'] = [{"id":"a","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[True]}]},
                 {"id":"b","source":"t","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[True]},{"t":1,"values":[True]}]}]
r = run(req6)
check('per_source_support', r['classes'], [])
# but with both contexts in source s -> eligible
req7 = copy.deepcopy(req6)
req7['train'] = [{"id":"a","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[True]},{"t":1,"values":[True]}]},
                 {"id":"b","source":"t","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[True]},{"t":1,"values":[True]}]}]
r = run(req7)
check('per_source_support_ok', [c['members'] for c in r['classes']], [1])

# per-source witness requirement: W=2, each source needs 2 exclusive witnesses
req8 = {
 "version":1,"window":1,
 "schema":[{"name":"f","type":"FLAG"},{"name":"g","type":"FLAG"}],
 "atoms":[{"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"f","at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}},
          {"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"g","at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}}],
 "policy":{"max_width":2,"min_support":1,"min_witness":2},
 "train":[{"id":"a","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[True,False]},{"t":1,"values":[True,False]}]},
          {"id":"b","source":"t","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[True,True]},{"t":1,"values":[True,True]}]}],
 "probes":[{"id":"p","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[False,False]}]}],
 "queries":[{"id":"q","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[False,True]}]}]}
# literals f+, g+ ; clause {f,g}: witnesses for f = ctxs where f true, g false:
#   source s: 2 ctx (both f=T,g=F) ok; source t: 0 -> fails. clause ineligible.
# singletons: f true on all 4 ctx (both sources >=2) -> eligible; g: source s has 0 true -> cond2 fails.
r = run(req8)
check('witness_per_source', [(c['members'], c['representative']) for c in r['classes']],
      [(1, {'or':[{'atom':0,'negated':False}]})])
check('witness_query', r['queries'], [{'trace':'q','end':0,'must':0,'may':0,'status':'consistent'}])

# (d) negated literal in representative
req9 = copy.deepcopy(req8)
req9['policy']['min_witness'] = 1
req9['train'] = [{"id":"a","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[False,False]}]}]
# atoms f,g both false on training -> literals f-,g- true; singletons eligible (probe true on both)
r = run(req9)
check('negated_literal', sorted(json.dumps(c['representative']) for c in r['classes']),
      sorted(['{"or":[{"atom":0,"negated":true}]}','{"or":[{"atom":1,"negated":true}]}']))

# (e) queries do not affect classes
base = {
 "version":1,"window":2,
 "schema":[{"name":"v","type":"SIZE","min":0,"max":9}],
 "atoms":[{"cmp":"ge","left":{"field":"v","at":1},"right":{"const":5,"type":"SIZE"}}],
 "policy":{"max_width":3,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
 "train":[{"id":"tr","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[1]},{"t":1,"values":[9]}]}],
 "probes":[{"id":"pr","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[0]},{"t":1,"values":[1]}]}],
 "queries":[]}
r0 = run(base)
base2 = copy.deepcopy(base)
base2['queries'] = [{"id":"q1","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[0]},{"t":1,"values":[9]}]},
                    {"id":"q2","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[7]},{"t":1,"values":[0]}]}]
r2 = run(base2)
check('queries_no_effect', r0['classes'] and r2['classes'] and
      sorted((c['signature'],c['members']) for c in r0['classes']) ==
      sorted((c['signature'],c['members']) for c in r2['classes']), True)
check('end_value', [q['end'] for q in r2['queries']], [1, 1])

# window K=2: contexts are sliding, offset0=older
req10 = {
 "version":1,"window":2,
 "schema":[{"name":"v","type":"SIZE","min":0,"max":9}],
 "atoms":[{"cmp":"gt","left":{"field":"v","at":1},"right":{"field":"v","at":0}}],
 "policy":{"max_width":2,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
 "train":[{"id":"tr","source":"s","rows":[{"t":5,"values":[9]},{"t":1,"values":[1]},{"t":3,"values":[4]}]}],
 "probes":[{"id":"pr","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[5]},{"t":1,"values":[2]},{"t":2,"values":[1]}]}],
 "queries":[{"id":"q","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[0]},{"t":1,"values":[1]},{"t":2,"values":[5]}]}]}
# sorted rows t=1(1),3(4),5(9): contexts [1,4]-> 4>1 T ; [4,9] -> 9>4 T. atom true on both train ctx.
# probes sorted 0(5),1(2),2(1): ctx [5,2]: 2>5 F ; [2,1]: F -> atom false on both probes
# eligible: {atom0} (true on all train, false on probes), and {atom0neg}? false on train -> no.
r = run(req10)
check('sliding_window', [(c['members'],c['signature']) for c in r['classes']], [(1,'0')])
# queries: ctx [0,1]: 1>0 T -> clause true -> consistent; ctx [1,5]: 5>1 T -> consistent
check('sliding_queries', [q['status'] for q in r['queries']], ['consistent','consistent'])
check('sliding_ends', [q['end'] for q in r['queries']], [1,2])

print('FAILURES:', len(fails))
PYEOF
cd /app/dev && python3 semantic.py
